name: Jun Cowen
source:
She is one of only four Samurai Masters of the divine nation of Tesurai.
Though a woman, her abilities are said to surpass even those of the great generals who command armies.

While it's hard to imagine from her status and strength, she has a generally cheerful and friendly personality, and some commoners have even become friends with her without even realizing she is a Samurai Master.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1350333]Getchu[/url]]
